expressCart.blurb: An open-source Node.js shop with MongoDB, about 2.2k GitHub stars. PayPal through the deprecated v1 Payments redirect (paypal-rest-sdk).

shotCrop.caption: The shop's admin order page: order status and total

simple-clothing-store.blurb: A small React + Express store with Printful fulfilment. PayPal through JS SDK v5 in the browser and the deprecated @paypal/checkout-server-sdk.
simple-clothing-store.beforeNote: In the original shop's runs, the harness's own PayPal client plays the browser half (creating and capturing the PayPal order, as the shop's v5 button code does); the shop's own server handles the rest.
simple-clothing-store.modeNote: Demo mode is the store's published demo setting (DEMO=1); production mode switches on its Printful order hand-off.

shotCrop.caption: The shop's order page: its badge and total
shotCrop.note: This shop's pages label every price "$ USD"; its orders are in EUR.
